Dear Sir/Madam, 
Intimation of conference call for Institutional Investors/Analyst – Financial Results for the quarter 
and half year ended September 30, 2026 
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and in continuation of our letter no. SEC/243/2026 dated 
October 5, 2026, we wish to inform you that the Bank will host an Institutional Investors/Analyst 
conference call to discuss about the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 
September 30, 2026, on October 23, 2026, at 05:00 pm IST and the details relating to the aforesaid 
conference call is enclosed herewith. 
 
The unaudited financial results and related Investor Presentation after being released to the stock 
exchanges, shall be made available on the Bank’s website, www.csb.bank.in. 
 
The audio recordings of the conference call shall be made available on the Bank’s website 
https://csb.bank.in/investor-relations  under the head ‘Earnings Call’ within the prescribed time. 
 
This intimation shall also be made available on the Bank’s website at www.csb.bank.in 
 
Kindly take the same on records. 
 
Thanking You, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
 
 
 
Sijo Varghese 
   Company Secretary
